theorem.fixed_bar_premise: THE INDEPENDENT FIXED_BAR NECESSITY FALSIFICATION PROVES EACH PUBLIC SCORE IDENTITY IS A PREDECLARED EVIDENCE ROUTE, NOT A TERMINAL AXIOM, PROVIDED A SOUND SCOPE_EQUIVALENT OR STRONGER CERTIFICATE COVERS THE SAME TERMINALLY RELEVANT BEHAVIOR AND HARD CONSTRAINTS.
theorem.abc_premise: V9 COMPLETE ABC REQUIRES EVERY ACTUAL TARGET CONTEXT TO BE SOUNDLY COVERED BY A SELECTED CELL WITH TARGET_RELATIVE ADEQUACY/DOMINANCE AND COMPLETE LOAD_BEARING EVALUATOR/HARD_CONSTRAINT SEMANTICS OR SOUNDLY EXCLUDED.
theorem.fixed_bar_consequence: FOR EACH OF THE 13 FIXED_BAR SCOPES, IF THE BENCHMARK_RELEVANT USEFUL TARGET CONTEXTS ARE REPRESENTED IN ABC AND BRAIN IS TARGET_RELATIVE NONINFERIOR UNDER THE LOAD_BEARING BENCHMARK_SCOPE SEMANTICS, THE UNDERLYING CAPABILITY SCOPE IS PROVED; THE NUMERIC BAR REMAINS AN OPTIONAL LOCAL WITNESS ROUTE.
theorem.finance_consequence: FINANCE_UNCOVERED_SCOPE_AUDIT IS BY DEFINITION A SET OF TARGET CONTEXT LEAVES OUTSIDE PUBLIC BARS; COMPLETE ABC MUST REPRESENT AND DOMINATE THOSE LEAVES OR FAIL CLOSED.
theorem.synthesis_consequence: SYNTHESIS_MATCHED_QUALITY_COVERAGE_NONINFERIOR IS A TARGET_RELATIVE QUALITY/COVERAGE CONDITION ON SYNTHESIS CONTEXTS; THE CURRENT MATCHED_QUALITY METRIC IS ITSELF DERIVED FROM LOAD_BEARING COMPONENT SEMANTICS. COMPLETE ABC WITH THOSE SEMANTICS ENTAILS THE UNDERLYING SYNTHESIS SCOPE OBLIGATION.
theorem.conclusion: NONE OF THE DIRECT15 NEEDS TO REMAIN A SECOND TOP_LEVEL ACCEPTANCE CONJUNCT ON TOP OF A SOUND COMPLETE ABC COVER. ALL FIFTEEN REMAIN LOAD_BEARING LOCAL CELL SCOPE/EVIDENCE OBLIGATIONS INSIDE ABC.

normal_form.rule: THIS IS A NORMAL_FORM REBIND ONLY. IT DOES NOT CLAIM ANY DIRECT15 SCOPE IS CURRENTLY CLOSED.

fail_closed_reopen: A DIRECT15 BENCHMARK_RELEVANT OR AUDIT_RELEVANT TARGET CONTEXT IS NOT REPRESENTED IN THE ABC CONTEXT UNIVERSE.
A DIRECT15 LOAD_BEARING EVALUATOR HARD_CONSTRAINT HARNESS OR TARGET_CONFIGURATION DISTINCTION IS OMITTED FROM THE SELECTED CELL PREORDER.

AN ALTERNATIVE ABC CERTIFICATE IS WEAKER THAN THE SCOPE EXERCISED BY THE REPLACED DIRECT15 ROUTE.

relation_to_terminal_semantics.effect: ACCEPTANCE PROOF SEARCH COLLAPSES FROM FIFTEEN PARALLEL TOP_LEVEL RESULT CONJUNCTS PLUS STRUCTURAL QUEUES TO ONE COMPLETE ABC SEMANTIC COVER WITH FIFTEEN OPTIONAL/LOCAL EVIDENCE ROUTES.
relation_to_terminal_semantics.ownership: D/L2 BRAIN OWNERSHIP AND EFFECT CLOSURE REMAINS SEPARATE AND UNCHANGED.
